text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite the turf incident, the URA Finale is on track for a successful opening.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On top of that, <chrname> has won enough fans to be considered a star Umamusume and been chosen to take part!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Naturally, <chrname>, who has received overwhelming support as a star Umamusume, will be taking part!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Trainer Kiryuin and Happy Meek also managing to secure places in the race, I'm more fired up than ever!
